name: Arija (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arija (a tree, glass-blowing tools and waves on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Arija; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arija arms — tree, glass-blowing tools and waves
